meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, language-native tooling, and optionally CodeGraph knowledge graph. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审计代码库技术债，生成带修复优先级的报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在清理代码库、规划重构或提升代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Automatically audit technical debt and generate prioritized fix reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are cleaning up codebase, planning refactoring, or improving code quality

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会扫描代码仓库,从 9 个方面查找技术债务,每处都标明文件位置、严重程度和预计修复时间,最后生成一份 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md 报告,列出优先级最高的修复项和快速修复清单。
howto.when: 当你说出“tech debt”“code health”等关键词,或要求做代码库健康检查、技术债务审计、架构审查等时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计一下这个项目的技术债务。

say.note: 会从 9 个维度扫描并输出发现。

say.text: 找出需要优先清理的代码问题。
say.note: 会列出按影响排序的 Top 5。

howto.what_en: Claude scans the repo and audits technical debt across 9 dimensions. Each finding has file:line:col, severity, and effort estimate. It produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with priorities and quick wins.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, or architecture review, or when keywords like 'tech debt' or 'code health' are said.

say_en.text: Audit the technical debt in this project.
Find code issues that need priority cleanup.
